metadata.title: बुइसू: त्रिपुरी जनजाति का उत्सव | Buisu: New Year celebration of Tripuri Tribe | Longthrang Valley
metadata.description: Dive into the rich cultural heritage of the Tripuri people with our channel exploring the significance of Buisu, their traditional New Year celebration. Originating from the Tripuri root word 'bisi,' meaning 'year,' Buisu marks the transition from the old year to the new. In the past, Tripuri communities relied heavily on jhum cultivation for their livelihoods, making it essential to accurately mark the beginning and end of the year. Join us as we delve into the customs, rituals, and importance of Buisu in Tripuri society, shedding light on its deep-rooted connections to agriculture, community, and tradition."
